skill.magical.gabriel.desc: A Tier 5 origin-created divine command born from Sovereign Aegis and Judgement. Hold to choose Ultimate Protection, Judgement, Perfect Seal, or Holy Field. The original two skills are destroyed by the creation formula.
skill.magical.gabriel_ultimate_protectio: Gabriel's defensive command. Nullifies incoming damage while active and consumes mana when protection answers an attack.
skill.magical.gabriel_judgement.desc: Gabriel's verdict command. Locks a target and calls down a catastrophic divine beam.
skill.magical.gabriel_perfect_seal.desc: Gabriel's sealing command. Seals one living target inside a divine law dome until released or replaced.
skill.magical.gabriel_holy_field.desc: Gabriel's field command. Forms a divine ritual through seed, cross, diagonal, and final-circle phases before the completed field repeatedly impales targets with light.
skill.magical.space_walker.desc: Tier 4 spatial magic. Blink to the safe block you are looking at, or sneak-use to open coordinate and waypoint folds.
skill.magical.black_flames.desc: Tier -3 created magic born by borrowing the fire element from Flare Ring and drowning it in Abyssal Discharge. Use it to cast a fast black ember that blooms into a lingering ritual flame field. Inputs are preserved.
skill.magical.black_flames_cast.desc: Launches a fast cursed ember. Impact creates a menacing black flame field that burns, withers, slows, weakens, and pulls victims deeper into the corrupted ground.
skill.magical.black_flames_imbue.desc: Coats your sword or axe in black flame. Melee hits flare into cursed slashes, leave small lingering flame scars, and apply abyssal corrosion.
skill.magical.black_flames_brand.desc: Brands the target with a hidden abyssal flame. If a branded player casts magic before it fades, the brand detonates into a black flame punishment field.
skill.magical.arcane_snap.desc: An instant touch that pins the target's facing: it can walk and jump, but cannot turn, and anything it attacks outside its frozen bearing takes nothing. Sneak turns the victim to face away first.
skill.magical.lodestone.desc: Plants a magnetite needle at the aimed face that bends every hostile projectile nearby toward itself and swallows what reaches it, until it has eaten its fill. Sneak reverses the polarity and repels instead.
skill.magical.retrograde.desc: Inscribes a glyph that records where every nearby hostile stood, then snaps them all back to those spots a few seconds later, hurting them for every block they travelled. Sneak inscribes it at your own feet.
skill.magical.arcane_exile.desc: Exiles the first living thing hit: for a while nothing can hurt it and it can hurt nothing; on return it takes the toll and reflects the harm it tried to deal. Sneak aims backward.
skill.magical.puppet_sigil.desc: Five rune-threads string a target's limbs to your hand: it walks wherever you look, striking whatever you walk it into, until the strings are cut. Sneak reverses it away from your aim.
skill.magical.echoes_of_passage.desc: A halo stamps a glass hourglass echo wherever you go; when the recording ends the echoes detonate in order, so your own path becomes the fuse. Sneak stacks every echo at the cast point.
skill.magical.smokestack.desc: Plants a chimney of dense black smoke: nothing inside can find a target, nothing can target through it, and lingering in it chokes. Sneak plants it at your own feet.
skill.magical.slag_roller.desc: Kicks a molten boulder rolling along your look: it climbs steps, bounces off walls, bowls over and ignites whatever it meets, then shatters into an ember ring. Sneak rolls it back from your heels.
skill.magical.wildfire.desc: Seeds a walking line of flame on the aimed surface that creeps one cell at a time with your look as the wind, around corners and up stairs, leaving scorch behind. Sneak reverses the wind.
skill.magical.magma_vent.desc: Cracks the aimed ground and heaves up a solid column of magma rock that throws and burns whatever stood there, then stands as real cover you can climb. Sneak erupts it under your own feet.
skill.magical.ash_effigy.desc: Hurls a fist of ash that rises into an effigy of you: every hostile nearby is drawn onto it instead of you, and when it falls it bursts into blinding, burning ash. Sneak throws it backward.
skill.magical.crucible.desc: Seals the aimed ground inside a kiln of slag ribs and molten glass: nothing living leaves or enters unless a wall is broken, and the heat inside climbs until it shatters outward. Sneak seals it around yourself.
skill.magical.rip_current.desc: Lays a flowing lane of water along your look: allies ride it as a speed lane, enemies are dragged and ground along it and flung off the far end. Sneak reverses the flow.
skill.magical.rime_snap.desc: Snaps a bloom of hoarfrost onto the aimed surface that roots every foot caught under it. Sneak stamps it under your own feet.
skill.magical.drowning_bell.desc: Seals a globe of still water over the target's head with its own breath ledger; when the breath runs out it drowns. One hit from anyone else pops the globe. Sneak holds it at arm's length instead.
skill.magical.ice_rampart.desc: Raises a solid wall of faceted ice across your look: a real obstacle for everyone that stops arrows, spells and sight until it is chipped away. Sneak raises it along your look instead.
skill.magical.deluge_jet.desc: A pressurized jet of water from your hand that you steer by looking while the key is held: it shoves and grinds everything along it and erodes soft ground where it strikes. Sneak fires it back over your shoulder.
skill.magical.leviathan_coil.desc: Floods the aimed ground with a standing sea: everything in it is truly swimming, dragged toward the centre by an undertow and struck by swells, until it drains and every block is restored. Sneak centres it on you.
skill.magical.glint.desc: Lobs a lens-bead that airbursts: everyone with a line of sight to it is dazzled and slowed. Cover blocks it. Sneak lobs it back over your shoulder.
skill.magical.lantern_brand.desc: Hangs a lantern on the target that pulses a halo searing and scattering everyone around it except its host, so its own pack cannot stand near it. Sneak reverses the pulses to draw them in.
skill.magical.revelation.desc: Plants a lantern whose blade of light sweeps a full circle, revealing every hostile it passes through walls for you and your team and stripping their invisibility. Sneak sweeps the other way.
skill.magical.crimson_tithe.desc: Signs a pact for a time: blood you spill on others returns to your Crimson Vessel, and blood spilled out of you returns faster still. Deals no damage at all - it only makes the fight you were already in worth something.
skill.magical.hemorrhage.desc: Opens a bleeding field where you aim. Everything standing in it keeps bleeding, and every drop of it fills your Vessel, so a crowd is a refill rather than a problem. Larger the closer you are to death.
skill.magical.blood_manipulation.desc: Crouch and use it to draw a shape; hold it and press a number to throw your blood along that shape. Everything the blood sweeps through as it forms is cut once. The drawing decides where, never how much - what you draw only decides what it costs you.
skill.magical.scarlet_lance.desc: A lance thrown from your own blood, and the only blood skill the Vessel may not pay for - it costs the body, always. Scales harder with your wounds than anything else in the school, and below a quarter health it runs clean through whatever it kills.
skill.magical.second_heart.desc: Moves some of your health out of your body and into a reserve. You are frailer for it, and casting stronger because of it, and the first blow that would have killed you spends the reserve instead of your life.
skill.magical.vein_walk.desc: Dissolves you and puts you back together at the furthest blood you have spilled. Your escape route is whatever you killed a moment ago - with no trail, there is nowhere to go.
skill.magical.exsanguinate.desc: Opens a tether to one target and holds it open for as long as you keep the key down. Each pull takes a share of whatever health it still has and pours it into your Vessel, so it is cruellest against something healthy.
skill.magical.cleansing_ray.desc: Three piercing rays from your eyes strip every potion effect from whoever they cross and leave them unable to receive any new one for a while. Sneak fans the rays vertically.
skill.magical.prism_cascade.desc: Commits your aim to a bar of light that ricochets off walls: after the seams show, light floods the whole path at once and stays as hardlight. A skill-shot you bank off corners.
skill.magical.heavens_gaze.desc: Opens a colossal eye above you whose searchlight glides toward wherever you look; whatever stands in the light is judged and, when its gaze fills, smitten.
skill.magical.hollow_maw.desc: Opens an iris-mouth ahead of your hand for a moment: it eats every hostile projectile that enters, refunding mana, then snaps shut on everything living in front of it. Sneak opens it behind you.
skill.magical.hushwing.desc: Releases a flock of ink moths that finds the nearest hostile and clings around its head; anything inside the flock is hushed and cannot cast. Sneak keeps the flock as a halo around you.
skill.magical.gravemoons.desc: Three obsidian shards orbit you: each strikes whatever it touches and shatters to erase the first hostile projectile that reaches it. Sneak tightens and reverses the orbit.
skill.magical.antithesis.desc: Places a free-standing pane that inverts whatever crosses it from the far side: projectiles are mirrored back at their shooters, enemies bounce off with their effects flipped. You pass freely. Sneak places it behind you.
skill.magical.gullet_of_the_deep.desc: Opens the aimed ground into a fanged pit: everything standing there drops in and is chewed and pinned until it closes bottom-up and spits its victims out with a final bite.
skill.magical.fallen_firmament.desc: A vast black disc descends over the aimed ground until it hangs just above it: hostile projectiles touching it are erased, everything under it is hushed, and anything taller than the gap is pinned against the sky.
skill.magical.transposition.desc: The two hostiles nearest the aim point exchange positions and facing, keeping their own momentum. A lone hostile swaps with a stake at the aim point. Sneak mirrors the aim point through yourself.
skill.magical.shortreach.desc: A rune tape binds the target's arms: its reach is clamped so it must literally touch you to hurt you. Sneak reaches straight behind you.
skill.magical.compression.desc: A three-ring gauge snaps shut around the nearest creature and ratchets it smaller in three clicks; it stays shrunk and barely able to clear a block. Sneak reverses the polarity and enlarges it instead.
skill.magical.rigid_frame.desc: After a telegraph every hostile nearby is locked at its exact offset from you: carried wherever you walk, jump or fall, never able to close or retreat. Struts that would push someone into terrain snap. Sneak anchors the hub at the cast point.
skill.magical.crease_fold.desc: Scores a seam across the aimed ground; after the windup the far half folds over it, mirroring every hostile there across the seam and slamming them down. Sneak folds the near half over instead.
skill.magical.diaspora.desc: A star-crack opens with one arm per hostile; after the windup each is flung down its own arm to a far exit so the pack is broken and no two land together. Sneak centres the starburst on your own feet.
skill.magical.heated_iron.desc: A heated palm brands the target: every pulse burns through armour and scales with how much armour it wears, and its armour is halved while branded.
skill.magical.dawnhammer.desc: Conjures a hammer of forge-light and swings it down: everything in the arc is driven to the ground, its flight cancelled and any barrier it carries shattered. Sneak swings behind you.
skill.magical.gilded_chain.desc: Rivets the two hostiles nearest the aim point together with a chain of light: neither can stray from the other, the taut chain yanks and bites, and anyone else crossing it burns. Sneak rivets a third stake at the aim point.
skill.magical.iron_charge.desc: Surge along your look with an arcane ram-wedge at the chest, throwing everything you overlap aside and shrugging off knockback. Sneak charges backward.
skill.magical.sunder_grip.desc: A double-helix coil bores out of your forearm and clamps the first thing it reaches: staggered and disarmed, its weapon wrenched out to hover under your sigil before flying home. Sneak wrenches the off-hand.
skill.magical.bloodshout.desc: A roar that forces every hostile nearby onto you: their hits on you land softer, and the first hit each one lands sears it. Sneak aims the shout as a cone.
skill.magical.living_bulwark.desc: Your body becomes a wall: no impulse can move you, whoever touches you is stopped and ejected, and every hit you take restores a little barrier. Sneak plants the stance.
skill.magical.hail_volley.desc: Marks the aimed ground for a rain of ice bolts from a sky sigil; every bolt dies on the first block it meets, so cover is safe and the open is not. Sneak centres the rain on yourself.
skill.magical.spirit_wolf.desc: A spectral wolf fights at your side, hunting whatever you last struck, harrying it so it cannot sprint. Recasting refreshes it. Sneak sends it to guard the aimed spot.
skill.magical.lead_shot.desc: The trigger is pulled now but the round arrives where the runner on your sightline WILL be; a glass collet slides ahead of it until the shot materialises and bursts. Sneak leads longer.
skill.magical.arcane_grasp.desc: A telekinetic grip hoists whatever you aim at, creature or block, and hangs it in the air before letting it fall; a dropped block lands as debris. Sneak holds it while the key is held.
skill.magical.arcanum_hare.desc: Transmutes the first living thing hit into a harmless porcelain hare that hops away from harm and cracks with every hit; six cracks or the timer end it. Sneak transforms yourself as an escape.
skill.magical.leech_cut.desc: An instant short line from your eye that ignores armour; you heal a share of what it actually dealt, and overheal becomes barrier. Sneak stabs backward.
skill.magical.somnolent_draught.desc: A flask shatters into a pool of sleep vapour: everything inside except you and yours falls asleep until hurt. Sneak shatters it at your own feet.
skill.magical.contagion.desc: A lancet infects the first hostile crossed; the plague beats on a shared clock, rotting every carrier and copying itself to whoever stands next to one. Sneak seeds it on yourself as a harmless carrier.
skill.magical.unstable_compound.desc: Plants a volatile reagent on the first creature along your look; it rides its carrier for a fixed fuse and detonates wherever the carrier is, so a fleeing mob delivers it into its friends. Sneak plants it as a timed mine.
skill.magical.scalding_geyser.desc: Spell Creator hybrid of Magma Vent and Deluge Jet: a geyser bore that erupts on a timer, launching allies as a launch pad and scalding enemies, hissing a slowing steam ring between. Sneak bores it under your feet.
skill.magical.dawnwell.desc: Spell Creator hybrid of Glint and Rip Current: a fountain whose lit droplets hang in a sphere, healing and shielding allies inside while dazzling and scalding enemies. Sneak fountains at your feet.
skill.magical.black_orrery.desc: Spell Creator hybrid of Gravemoons and Rigid Frame: every hostile nearby is forced onto an orbit around you, bitten and stripped each time it passes the dark node. Sneak reverses the orbit.
skill.magical.cinder_chariot.desc: Spell Creator hybrid of Slag Roller and Puppet Sigil: a molten spoked wheel you mount and steer by looking, burning and bowling over whatever it rolls across. Press again or sneak to dismount.
skill.magical.fallen_sun.desc: Magic Originator ultimate born from Crucible and Cleansing Ray: a solid sun of molten glass that radiates purging heat rings and pours a focal beam you steer by looking. Consumes both inputs.
skill.magical.total_eclipse.desc: Magic Originator ultimate born from Fallen Firmament and Glint: a black disc that follows your aim, blinding, hushing and pressing everything in its shadow while its burning rim throws back anyone who tries to leave. Consumes both inputs.
skill.magical.tectonic_verdict.desc: Magic Originator ultimate born from Magma Vent and Crease: two rock plates hinge up on either side of a molten seam, sliding everything on them into the jaws that crush and hold. Consumes both inputs. Sneak seams under your feet.
skill.magical.abyssal_discharge.desc: A Tier -2 dark discharge that erupts in every direction, corroding nearby targets with heavy decay, weakness, slowness, and fatigue.
skill.magical.vault_of_avarice.desc: A Tier -4 Greed utility skill that opens a private mana vault store. Deposited mana cannot be withdrawn directly and is spent on permanent growth.
skill.magical.create_subspace.desc: Authority of Space: define a transparent spherical subspace. Hold to increase its radius; sneak while releasing to attach it to yourself. Casting again dismisses the current subspace.
skill.magical.manipulate_space.desc: Authority of Space: hold the direct slot key while inside your subspace to choose a physics rule, operation, and target group from three control wheels.
skill.magical.pocket_dimension.desc: Authority of Space: open a private lost-space chamber. Normal use folds only you inside; sneak-use leaves a temporary portal so others can follow. The exit door inside returns you to the cast point.
skill.magical.spatial_arsenal.desc: Authority of Space: open an offensive command wheel for direct spatial attacks that do not require an active subspace.
skill.magical.singularity.desc: Condense space into a pitch-black light-bending sphere. It pulls entities inward, crushes anything too close, and annihilates spherical chunks of terrain when it touches blocks.
skill.magical.dimensional_guillotine.des: Authority of Space: open a vertical rift at the looked position. After a short charge, the rift snaps shut and cuts every entity caught in that plane while dragging their coordinates out of alignment.
skill.magical.soul_vow.desc: Authority of Soul: open a wheel of binding laws that connect souls, survival, identity, and death.
skill.magical.soul_valley.desc: Bind your soul to a non-hostile living entity. Death on one side resurrects that soul near the other and opens a collapse window. Repeated deaths on the same side keep reviving; the vow only collapses if the opposite soul dies during that window, or if either side breaks the bond.
authority.magical.authority_of_space.des: The right to define a local space and rewrite the rules within it.
authority.magical.authority_of_soul.desc: The right to bind, preserve, fracture, and restore the essence of living beings.
space.magical.release_hint: Scroll to spin. Left/right click changes wheel. Release the skill key to apply.
passive.magical.mana_skin.desc: Your body naturally holds magic barrier.
passive.magical.bloodscent.desc: Anything wounded near you is lit up through walls, and anything you kill while it is lit leaves twice the blood behind.
passive.magical.clotting.desc: Halves the healing an open wound costs you, and turns your own slow recovery into a trickle of Vessel once the wound has closed.
passive.magical.vessel_overflows.desc: A Vessel filled past four fifths stops holding the surplus and spends it on barrier instead.
passive.magical.heat_resistance.desc: Reduces fire and freeze damage by 20% per level.
passive.magical.poison_resistance.desc: Reduces poison damage by 20% per level.
passive.magical.magic_resistance.desc: Reduces magic damage by 20% per level.
passive.magical.steady_breathing.desc: Stabilizes your mana flow and marks you as compatible with future breathing, focus, and spell-control mechanics.
passive.magical.mana_sustenance.desc: Keeps your hunger full by converting hunger loss into a tiny mana drain.
passive.magical.cooldown_echo.desc: Every 4th/3rd/2nd successful cast of the same skill ignores that skill's cooldown.
passive.magical.mana_flight.desc: Grants creative-style flight while enabled. Mana drains only while actively flying.
passive.magical.barrier_conversion.desc: If you lack mana for a skill, burn magic barrier to cover the missing mana. Higher levels waste less barrier, but conversion is always worse than refilling barrier.
passive.magical.vault_tap.desc: A Greed store passive. If normal mana, Hoard, and barrier conversion cannot pay for a skill, the mana vault can cover the missing amount at triple cost.
passive.magical.sin_pride.desc: Builds Pride when stronger players damage you. High Pride empowers your next offensive skill with extra damage and size, rewarding fights against opponents above your level.
passive.magical.sin_greed.desc: Kills feed a Hoard. When mana is short, Greed can burn Hoard at poor efficiency to finish paying a skill cost, turning excess spoils into emergency casting fuel.
passive.magical.sin_lust.desc: Holding your gaze on a living target drains a small amount of mana and pressures them with weakness, slowness, and nausea based on power difference.
passive.magical.sin_envy.desc: Surviving hits from skills you do not own builds per-skill Envy. When enough exposure accumulates, the skill may awaken for you without stealing anything from the original caster.
passive.magical.sin_gluttony.desc: Periodically devours part of incoming magic damage, restoring mana. Excess eaten magic becomes Mana Charge, which accelerates natural mana recovery.
passive.magical.sin_wrath.desc: Taking damage builds Wrath. Your next offensive skill consumes Wrath for extra damage and knockback.
passive.magical.sin_sloth.desc: Calm movement builds Stillness, reducing mana cost and cooldowns. Sleeping or staying in bed for ten seconds grants Rested Stillness.
passive.magical.mana_leak_curse.desc: An unstable curse that interferes with mana retention. It exists as a general curse hook for future mana-drain and dispel testing.
passive.magical.sin_pride_curse.desc: The crown tightens inward and rejects easy victories. Pride is meant to offer no comfort against weak prey, and retreat or farming weaker enemies should drain its momentum. This curse appears automatically while Pride is owned; disable Pride, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_greed_curse.desc: The hand closes around what was never held. Greed is meant to punish an empty Hoard with worse resource pressure, making careless spending feel dangerous. This curse appears automatically while Greed is owned; disable Greed, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_lust_curse.desc: The heart answers voices that are not there. Lust is meant to make fixation risky: a target you pressure may become more dangerous to you through counters, resistance, or retaliation. This curse appears automatically while Lust is owned; disable Lust, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_envy_curse.desc: The mirror learns to breathe behind your eyes. Envy gains nothing from suffering skills you already own, and repeated useless exposure is meant to twist into curse pressure instead of progress. This curse appears automatically while Envy is owned; disable Envy, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_gluttony_curse.desc: The hollow place below mana begins to chew. Gluttony is meant to hunger when it has not devoured magic recently, making passive recovery feel worse until it feeds again. This curse appears automatically while Gluttony is owned; disable Gluttony, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_wrath_curse.desc: The verdict burns before the crime is named. Wrath is meant to favor retaliation over defense, making purely defensive or hesitant play more costly while rage is awake. This curse appears automatically while Wrath is owned; disable Wrath, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
passive.magical.sin_sloth_curse.desc: The world slows where your shadow touches it. Sloth punishes a sleepless night: if you stay awake around 1 AM without resting in bed for ten seconds, fatigue, weakness, and slowness follow. This curse appears automatically while Sloth is owned; disable Sloth, keep it silent for five real minutes, then dispel.
class.magical.warsmith.desc: A smith who forges for the front line, trading ornament for lethality.
class.magical.apprentice.desc: The first lessons of the forge: heat, hammer, patience.
class.magical.tempersmith.desc: Mastery of the quench, drawing hardness out of raw metal.
class.magical.engraver.desc: Cutting runes into steel so the metal remembers its purpose.
class.magical.armorer.desc: Plate and mail, shaped to turn a blow aside.
class.magical.runewright.desc: Rune and metal answer to the same hand.
class.magical.weaponwright.desc: Edges that bite deeper than their steel should allow.
class.magical.bulwarksmith.desc: Work meant to stand between a friend and an ending.
class.magical.duelist.desc: One opponent, one blade, no wasted motion.
class.magical.vanguard.desc: First into the breach and last to give ground.
class.magical.reaver.desc: Momentum as a weapon; never stop swinging.
class.magical.sentinel.desc: A line held is worth more than ground taken.
class.magical.bloodletter.desc: Every wound opened feeds the next strike.
class.magical.warcaller.desc: A voice that turns a rabble into a wall.
class.magical.ironhide.desc: Skin like a shield wall, patience like stone.
class.magical.tracker.desc: Reading the ground for what passed and how long ago.
class.magical.fletcher.desc: The arrow matters as much as the arm that looses it.
class.magical.trapper.desc: Let the ground do the hunting for you.
class.magical.houndmaster.desc: The pack finds what one hunter never would.
class.magical.pathfinder.desc: No terrain is closed to someone who has read it.
class.magical.marksman.desc: Distance is only a number to a steady hand.
class.magical.packleader.desc: Beasts answer, and they answer gladly.
class.magical.channeler.desc: Raw mana, drawn through and shaped on the way out.
class.magical.warder.desc: The art of the barrier, held against what should not pass.
class.magical.bladesinger.desc: Spell and sword as a single motion.
class.magical.evoker.desc: Magic made loud, bright and immediate.
class.magical.duskblade.desc: Where the study turns toward the abyss and does not look away.
class.magical.herbalist.desc: Every green thing is a reagent to a patient eye.
class.magical.distiller.desc: Purity through repetition, essence through loss.
class.magical.toxicologist.desc: Dose is the only thing separating cure from poison.
class.magical.metallurgist.desc: Metals answer to heat, time and a precise hand.
class.magical.apothecary.desc: Remedies for the body, measured against the harm.
class.magical.venomancer.desc: Poison as an instrument rather than a blunt tool.
class.magical.chrysopoeian.desc: The old dream: base metal into something better.
class.magical.blacksmith.desc: Forge high-grade weapons by binding elemental attributes into swords and axes. Infused weapons fire projectile slashes and apply combat effects.
class.magical.divinesmith.desc: An evolution of Blacksmith. Divine weapons are intentionally overwhelming and are best countered by another divine-grade weapon.
class.magical.warrior.desc: A frontline combat class focused on weapon mastery, raw durability, and aggressive melee pressure.
class.magical.berserker.desc: An offensive Warrior evolution built around rage windows, high-risk damage spikes, and lifesteal-style sustain.
class.magical.warden.desc: A defensive Warrior evolution built around shields, guard counters, taunts, and party protection.
class.magical.ranger.desc: A mobile ranged class focused on bows, traps, tracking, and terrain control.
class.magical.beastmaster.desc: A Ranger evolution focused on companions, pack tactics, and empowering allied creatures.
class.magical.sharpshooter.desc: A Ranger evolution focused on precision shots, weak-point damage, and long-range execution.
class.magical.mystic.desc: A spellcasting class focused on mana flow, spell efficiency, and arcane utility.
class.magical.archmage.desc: A Mystic evolution focused on large-scale spell amplification, area control, and overwhelming mana output.
class.magical.spellblade.desc: A Mystic evolution that blends melee attacks with spell triggers, enchanted strikes, and arcane mobility.
class.magical.alchemist.desc: A crafting and support class focused on potions, volatile mixtures, bombs, and material conversion.
class.magical.plaguedoctor.desc: An Alchemist evolution focused on poisons, cures, debuffs, and disease-themed battlefield control.
class.magical.transmuter.desc: An Alchemist evolution focused on changing materials, upgrading resources, and unstable matter effects.
class.magical.spell_creator.desc: A class for creating new magic by combining owned skills into curated fusion formulas. Created magic is not gained from random proficiency rewards.
class.magical.magic_originator.desc: The evolution of Spell Creator. Originators can later combine Below Pyramid skills and Tier 5 formulas into mythic origin magic.
passive.magical.bellows_rhythm.desc: Casting the same skill again and again cuts its mana cost by 15% per repeat, up to 45%. Switching skills resets the rhythm.
passive.magical.quench.desc: While you are burning, incoming damage is cut by 30%. When the fire finally goes out you gain barrier worth 40% of what it cost you.
passive.magical.etched_grooves.desc: Each different skill you cast within 8 seconds adds 8% spell damage, up to 3 grooves. Repeating a skill cuts none.
passive.magical.fitted_plate.desc: Armour fitted by your own hand holds a ward as well as a blow: +5 maximum barrier for every point of armour you wear.
passive.magical.anvil_debt.desc: A spell you cannot afford still fires. The missing mana is borrowed and repaid out of your next regeneration at half again the price.
passive.magical.edge_alignment.desc: A weaponwright finishes the piece: +20% spell damage against anything already below half health.
passive.magical.countersunk.desc: While your barrier holds, a quarter of everything it soaks is driven straight back into whoever sent it.
passive.magical.gilded_ledger.desc: Every kill your magic takes is written down and paid out: +1 permanent maximum mana per spell kill, up to +60.
passive.magical.forge_heat.desc: Each cast raises your Heat, which decays over time. Spell damage rises 3% per Heat, but a forge at full temperature burns the smith standing at it.
passive.magical.single_combat.desc: +25% damage against the last thing you struck, but only while nothing else hostile stands within six blocks. An honour duel pays nothing in a brawl.
passive.magical.blood_tithe.desc: Melee hits return 2 mana and melee kills return 15. The swing pays, not the spell.
passive.magical.first_wall.desc: The first blow of an engagement lands 60% softer, provided nothing has touched you for six seconds.
passive.magical.braced_stance.desc: Plant your feet for two seconds and everything hits 20% softer. Any step you take gives it back.
passive.magical.red_payment.desc: Mana you do not have is paid in blood instead, one heart for every 16 mana. It will never take the last of you.
passive.magical.rally_cry.desc: Every cast is loud. Allies and your own animals within ten blocks hit harder for three seconds.
passive.magical.scar_tissue.desc: Every hit you take hardens you 5% against the next, up to 25%. Stop being hit and it fades away again.
passive.magical.deeper_wounds.desc: +2% spell damage for every tenth of your own health you are missing, up to +20%. A berserker is at their worst while winning comfortably.
passive.magical.held_ground.desc: Your barrier knits far faster while something hostile is standing within four blocks of you. A warden works in contact.
passive.magical.blood_trail.desc: Anything you wound is marked and glows for eight seconds. Your next hit on a marked target lands 15% harder.
passive.magical.broadhead.desc: A heavy head flies well and handles badly: +25% damage beyond twelve blocks, -10% inside four.
passive.magical.loose_ground.desc: A trapper leaves the footing worse than they found it. Your spells have a one in four chance to root what they hit.
passive.magical.kennel_bond.desc: Your tamed animals take 40% less damage. When one of them dies anyway, you hit 20% harder for six seconds.
passive.magical.long_stride.desc: +15% movement speed, and a drop of less than eight blocks does not touch you.
passive.magical.held_breath.desc: Stand still for a second and a half and your next spell lands as a certain critical, at half again the damage.
passive.magical.share_the_kill.desc: The pack eats first. Every kill heals each of your tamed animals within 24 blocks for a fifth of its health.
passive.magical.distant_eye.desc: +2% spell damage for every block past ten, with no ceiling at all. Anything within three blocks of you hits 20% harder in return.
passive.magical.second_pack.desc: Your tamed animals carry 30% more health and hit 25% harder. What a beastmaster owns is the weapon.
passive.magical.deepening_well.desc: Mana returns far faster while you are below a third of your pool. The well is deepest where it looks empty.
passive.magical.clean_casting.desc: Every fifth cast costs nothing. The count survives logging out.
passive.magical.ward_rebound.desc: Damage your barrier absorbs returns 30% of itself to you as mana. The ward feeds the well it came from.
passive.magical.cadence.desc: Strike within two seconds of a cast and the blow carries the spell with it. Cast within two seconds of a strike and it costs 30% less. Repeat either and you get nothing.
passive.magical.overchannel.desc: Sneak as you cast an offensive spell to overchannel it: double the mana for 60% more damage and reach. The only passive you fire on purpose.
passive.magical.null_field.desc: Magic thins out around you. You are immune to spell-borne afflictions outright, and enemies within five blocks deal 15% less spell damage to you.
passive.magical.abyssal_tithe.desc: Every spell kill leaves an abyssal mote where the body fell. Walk over it and it pays you 15 mana and a heart.
passive.magical.manifold.desc: Now and then the working folds and both castings arrive as one: a one in five chance of double damage and a wider reach.
passive.magical.edge_of_thought.desc: Your melee attacks carry bonus magic damage worth a tenth of your current mana, and spend 5 mana doing it.
passive.magical.wildcraft.desc: Breaking a plant has a one in four chance of returning 5 mana, and a meal is worth 10% spell damage for four seconds afterwards.
passive.magical.concentrate.desc: A distiller works at the extremes: spells costing over 40 mana hit 15% harder, spells under 20 cost a quarter less. The middle gets nothing.
passive.magical.building_tolerance.desc: Every affliction that lands on you teaches the body something. Each one shortens future afflictions by 10%, permanently, up to half.
passive.magical.slag_coat.desc: The first two damage of every single hit does not reach you at all. A metallurgist stops noticing the small stuff.
passive.magical.compounding_venom.desc: +12% spell damage for every separate affliction already on the target. Load them up before the dose arrives.
passive.magical.measured_dose.desc: All healing you receive is 30% stronger, but no single dose may exceed four hearts. The dose makes the poison.
passive.magical.base_metals.desc: Spell kills have a one in seven chance of leaving gold behind, and what they leave feeds your hoard.
passive.magical.miasma.desc: You walk in your own weather. Enemies within six blocks are steadily poisoned, poison cannot touch you, and anything already poisoned hits you 25% softer.
passive.magical.equivalent_exchange.desc: A blow that would kill you spends your entire mana pool instead, buying back a heart for every 20 mana. Once every three minutes.
skill.magical.anvil_fall.desc: A forge anvil the size of a cart hangs over the point you name, then falls. Everything the slam hurts is paid back to you as barrier, so the Warsmith armours themselves by hitting things.
skill.magical.sigil_forge.desc: A rune cut into whatever you are looking at and left there. It waits, inert, and goes off the moment something hostile crosses it, rooting whatever it catches. Sneak inscribes a wider sigil that will not wait as long.
skill.magical.war_horn.desc: One blast doing two jobs: everything in front of you is thrown back and everything behind you is hardened. Sneak narrows it into something that reaches down a corridor.
skill.magical.sight_line.desc: A single line drawn from your eye to the end of your sightline. Everything standing on it is hit, and hit harder the further down the line it stands. Sneak tightens the lane.
skill.magical.mana_bloom.desc: A bud of raw mana opens where you point it, dragging everything nearby inward the whole time it blooms, and paying out only when it finally opens. Sneak blooms tighter and faster.
skill.magical.vial_break.desc: A flask thrown on a real arc that breaks where it lands and leaves a pool eating whatever stands in it, stacking affliction on everything inside.
space.magical.preset_hint: 1-9 load a preset  -  Shift + 1-9 saves the current rule
skill.magical.circle_arsenal.desc: A Tier 5 sustained arcane arsenal. Hold to preview and expand a spherical domain, release to deploy inward-facing circles, and press again to dismiss. The field drains mana and fires reduced-power copies of owned offensive skills at targets inside.
skill.magical.divine_divider.desc: A sword-only divine cut that releases a massive long-range white shockwave. The slash travels forward like severing wind and hits each target once.
message.magical.circle_arsenal_hold: Hold the direct slot key to expand Circle Arsenal.
message.magical.divine_divider_requires_: Divine Divider requires a sword in your main hand.
skill.magical.flare_ring.desc: Mark up to three ground points with fire eruptions. Two points form a burning wall; three complete a searing triangle that traps and cooks enemies inside.
message.magical.flare_ring_no_ground: Flare Ring needs a solid ground point in sight.
message.magical.sovereign_aegis_parent: Equip Sovereign Aegis and choose this law from its wheel.
skill.magical.sovereign_aegis.desc: A Tier 5 divine law skill. Hold to choose Ultimate Protection, Sanctuary, or Perfect Seal. Each law is tuned separately in the Codex.
A toggle law that nullifies incoming damage while active. Hits periodically consume mana, but protection does not drop between mana payments unless mana runs out.
skill.magical.aegis_sanctuary.desc: Deploys a spherical law barrier that blocks outside attacks, but forbids offensive casting from inside so it cannot be used as a free attack bunker.
skill.magical.aegis_perfect_seal.desc: Seals one living target inside a divine dome. The sealed target is pulled back if displaced, cannot use magic, and cannot be damaged until the caster seals another target.
skill.magical.judgement.desc: A Tier 5 ultimate that locks a target, gathers red and gold circles above it, then drops a devastating beam.
message.magical.runeforge_locked: The Runeforge is still settling — try again in a moment.
forge.magical.error.no_weapon: Place a sword or axe in the forge.
forge.magical.error.kept_glyph_missing: Glyph %s is not on the weapon in the forge — redraw it.
forge.magical.error.missing_form: Add at least one form glyph.
forge.magical.error.operator_needs_form: An operator rune needs a form after it (glyph %s).
forge.magical.glyph.trigger.desc: The next form is nested inside the one before it, and fires at the first body that form touches.
forge.magical.glyph.fuse.desc: The nested form fires on a clock instead, eight ticks after the carrier is thrown. Stack it to burn faster.
forge.magical.glyph.wake.desc: The nested form fires when the carrier runs out, whether or not it ever hit anything.
forge.magical.glyph.wake.stroke: A fan bursting up off a line
forge.magical.glyph.fork.desc: The next two forms fire together on one press. Stack it for three, then four.
forge.magical.glyph.fork.stroke: A stem splitting into two arms
forge.magical.error.fusion_unknown_pair: Those two cores do not fuse.
forge.magical.error.fusion_locked_class: Only a Divinesmith can fuse this core.
forge.magical.error.fusion_needs_grade: Fusing two cores needs a Mythic sigil or better.
forge.magical.rider.plasma: Chains lightning, and every arc ignites
forge.magical.rider.magma: Leaves burning ground where it lands
forge.magical.rider.hailstorm: Chains, and every jump deepens the cold
forge.magical.rider.eclipse: Rot and blindness, and the undead still burn
forge.magical.rider.blight: Poison and rot, and healing that no longer works
forge.magical.rider.verdigris: Poisons the ground, and the ground poisons back
forge.magical.rider.black_flame: Burns through resistance, rots, and stops healing
forge.magical.rider.rime_gale: Freezes and hauls the target in
forge.magical.error.duplicate_modifier: That rune is stacked as high as it goes (glyph %s).
forge.magical.error.seeking_needs_projec: Seeking needs a Wave or Rising form.
forge.magical.error.divine_requires_forg: Divine grade can only upgrade a weapon forged at High or better.
forge.magical.error.cooldown: The runes are still settling: %s s.
forge.magical.error.misfire: The runes collapse — quality %s%%. Half the mana burned away.
screen.magical.forge_canvas_hint: Draw a rune. Enter commits · Backspace undoes · Delete clears
screen.magical.forge_preview_empty: Draw a grade sigil, an element core and at least one form.
screen.magical.forge_ambiguous_commit: That rune reads two ways — redraw it before committing.
forge.magical.rider.storm: Chains lightning to a nearby foe
forge.magical.rider.radiant: Glows, smites undead, heals a little
forge.magical.rider.terra: Tremor splashes and slows grounded foes
forge.magical.glyph.crude.stroke: Down, then right along the bottom (an L).
forge.magical.glyph.fine.stroke: Two level bars, top then bottom (=).
forge.magical.glyph.high.stroke: Down-right, left along the bottom, up to the apex (triangle).
forge.magical.glyph.master.stroke: Upper chevron, lower chevron, then a vertical bar through the diamond.
forge.magical.glyph.mythic.stroke: Upright triangle, then an inverted triangle.
forge.magical.glyph.divine.desc: 4 forms, 3 runes. 100% mana. Divinesmith only; upgrades a weapon forged at High or better.
forge.magical.glyph.divine.stroke: Ring, vertical bar, horizontal bar, then two short rays top-left and top-right.
forge.magical.glyph.fire.desc: Ignites on hit; extra damage to burning foes.
forge.magical.glyph.fire.stroke: Up to a low peak, dip, up to a tall peak, down (a flame).
forge.magical.glyph.frost.desc: Slows and freezes; extra damage to frozen foes.
forge.magical.glyph.frost.stroke: Level line, then two diagonals (six-armed star).
forge.magical.glyph.storm.desc: Chains lightning to a nearby foe.
forge.magical.glyph.void.stroke: Large ring, then a smaller ring inside it.
forge.magical.glyph.radiant.desc: Glows, smites the undead, heals a little.
forge.magical.glyph.radiant.stroke: Ring, then four short rays: top, right, bottom, left.
forge.magical.glyph.venom.stroke: An upright S, then a short fang from its tail.
forge.magical.glyph.terra.desc: Tremor splashes grounded foes and slows them.
forge.magical.glyph.gale.desc: Gusts foes away and quickens the wielder.
forge.magical.glyph.dark.desc: Blinds and weakens, and takes away the healing that would undo it. Hits harder once its target is already blind.
forge.magical.glyph.dark.stroke: Downward triangle, then one bar struck across it.
forge.magical.glyph.slash.stroke: One level stroke, left to right.
forge.magical.glyph.cleave.stroke: One vertical stroke, top to bottom.
forge.magical.glyph.thrust.stroke: Short shaft left to right, then a large > head.
forge.magical.glyph.slam.desc: Grounded shock disc; heavy adds a second ring.
forge.magical.glyph.slam.stroke: A V: down to a point, then up.
forge.magical.glyph.wave.desc: Flying crescent; light stops on the first hit.
forge.magical.glyph.wave.stroke: A level wave (~), left to right.
forge.magical.glyph.rising.stroke: Shaft bottom to top, then a wide ^ head.
forge.magical.glyph.flurry.stroke: Three short rising ticks, left to right.
forge.magical.glyph.keen.stroke: Vertical stroke, then a wide crossbar low on the blade.
forge.magical.glyph.heavy.desc: Wider and slower with far more knockback; charges faster.
forge.magical.glyph.heavy.stroke: Top bar, wider bottom bar, then the stem.
forge.magical.glyph.swift.desc: Shorter reach, quickest recovery, longer combo window.
forge.magical.glyph.swift.stroke: A check mark in one stroke.
forge.magical.glyph.pierce.desc: 20% of each hit ignores armor; thrusts and waves pass through.
forge.magical.glyph.haste.desc: Faster recovery and a longer combo window.
forge.magical.glyph.echo.desc: Each strike repeats at 40% six ticks later.
forge.magical.glyph.echo.stroke: Two nested arcs bulging left, outer then inner.
forge.magical.glyph.seeking.desc: Waves and rising strikes curve toward foes (needs Wave or Rising).
forge.magical.glyph.leech.desc: Heal 8% of damage dealt, up to 2 hearts per press.
forge.magical.glyph.brand.desc: Hits stack a brand; the finisher spends the stacks.
forge.magical.glyph.shatter.desc: Finisher +30% vs slowed, frozen, withered or poisoned foes.
forge.magical.glyph.shatter.stroke: Stem bottom-up, then a V opening upward (Y).
forge.magical.glyph.guard.desc: Take 30% less damage briefly after each strike; 50% while charging.
forge.magical.art.fire_thrust.desc: A charged thrust runs six blocks out, setting everything on the line alight for five seconds and biting 20% deeper into anything already burning.
forge.magical.art.fire_spin.desc: Every spin leaves a flame disc 2.5 blocks across for a second, searing everything inside it for a quarter of the blow every five ticks.
forge.magical.art.fire_slam.desc: A finishing or charged slam opens a burning ring three blocks across for four seconds: 1.0 damage every half second and a fresh two-second burn.
forge.magical.art.fire_flurry.desc: Each pulse of the flurry lays on another burn stack, up to three, and a finishing flurry bites 5% harder for every stack it is carrying.
forge.magical.art.frost_cleave.desc: A charged cleave into a frozen foe hits half again as hard and shatters it, splashing 30% of the blow two blocks around.
forge.magical.art.frost_spin.desc: The finishing spin opens a ring of ice three blocks across: Slowness III for two seconds and eighty more ticks of freeze.
forge.magical.art.frost_wave.desc: The crescent leaves a line of ground frost in its wake, dragging at the feet of whatever it passed.
forge.magical.art.frost_rising.desc: A charged rising cut throws the target up and pins it there for fifteen ticks, frozen.
forge.magical.art.storm_thrust.desc: The thrust becomes a rail eight blocks long, arcing on to two more foes standing on its line for 60% each.
forge.magical.art.storm_spin.desc: The finishing spin jumps to as many as four foes within five blocks, each for 45%.
forge.magical.art.storm_rising.desc: A charged rising cut launches the target, and ten ticks later a bolt falls out of the sky for 80%.
forge.magical.art.storm_flurry.desc: The charge builds across the flurry and lets go on the third pulse, discharging two blocks around for 50%.
forge.magical.art.void_thrust.desc: A charged thrust blinks you two blocks clean through the target, which takes an extra 20% on the way past.
forge.magical.art.void_spin.desc: The finishing spin sinks a gravity well 2.5 blocks across for thirty ticks, dragging foes inward and siphoning a mana from each every half second.
forge.magical.art.void_slam.desc: A charged slam tears a four-block seam that collapses ten ticks later for an extra 40%.
forge.magical.art.void_wave.desc: The crescent hauls everything within four blocks onto itself and leaves it withering.
forge.magical.art.radiant_slash.desc: The finishing slash burns half again as deep into the undead and lights the body up for five seconds.
forge.magical.art.radiant_spin.desc: The finishing spin consecrates three blocks of ground for two seconds: allies mend 1.0, the undead take 3.0.
forge.magical.art.radiant_wave.desc: The crescent runs on through three foes in all, marking every one of them with glowing.
forge.magical.art.radiant_rising.desc: A charged rising cut launches the target; you mend 2.0 and allies within three blocks mend 1.0.
forge.magical.art.venom_thrust.desc: A charged thrust drives the venom deep: Poison II for five seconds and Weakness for three.
forge.magical.art.venom_slam.desc: The finishing slam bursts a three-block bloom of poison and Slowness II, splashing 40% of the blow.
forge.magical.art.venom_wave.desc: The crescent leaves a low cloud behind for three seconds, poisoning whatever walks into it.
forge.magical.art.venom_flurry.desc: Each pulse of the flurry sinks another fang, up to four, and the poison deepens by one every second fang.
forge.magical.art.terra_slash.desc: The slash adds a blunt sunder that armour does not stop, and shoves half again as hard.
forge.magical.art.terra_cleave.desc: The cleave cracks the ground open for six blocks, hitting for 50% and throwing whatever it runs under.
forge.magical.art.terra_slam.desc: A finishing or charged slam shakes four blocks of ground: 60% splash to anything still standing on it, and a one-second stagger.
forge.magical.art.terra_rising.desc: A charged rising cut drives a stone pillar up under the target and throws it clear.
forge.magical.art.gale_slash.desc: The slash keeps going as a blade of wind for ten blocks, so a swing that connected in melee still reaches whatever stood behind it.
forge.magical.art.gale_spin.desc: The finishing spin winds up for thirty ticks: it hauls everything in for half a second, then throws everything within four blocks outward.
forge.magical.art.gale_rising.desc: A charged rising cut hangs the target on the wind for twenty ticks, then lets it drift back down.
forge.magical.art.gale_flurry.desc: The flurry reaches a block further, and each of its pulses carries you half a block further onto the target.
screen.magical.race_select_hint: Your race sets where you begin, not where you may go. This choice is permanent.
race.magical.human.desc: Balanced growth. No path is closed and none is favoured.
race.magical.elf.desc: A deep well of mana and an easy hand with arcane and elemental work.
race.magical.dwarf.desc: Earth and metal. Built to take a hit and keep working.
race.magical.beastkin.desc: Instinct over study. The hunt feeds what the hunt spends.
race.magical.demon.desc: At home in the dark. Sin settles on you far more slowly.
race.magical.celestial.desc: Rare blood, divine leaning. Mending answers when you ask it.
passive.magical.adaptable.desc: You reach each tuning rank one point ahead: 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 11. The ceiling of 11 is unchanged - you get there sooner, not further.
passive.magical.deep_well.desc: +40 maximum mana, and every spell costs 12% less to cast.
passive.magical.forgeborn.desc: +30 maximum barrier, and all incoming damage is reduced by 8% before the barrier takes it.
passive.magical.quickened_instinct.desc: +10 maximum barrier. Every kill returns 6 mana and 2 barrier.
passive.magical.corruption_resistance.de: +20 maximum mana. Every sin gauge rises at 40% of the usual rate. Clearing sin is unaffected.
passive.magical.blessed.desc: +30 maximum mana, +20 maximum barrier, and all healing you receive is increased by 20%.
screen.magical.loadout_bind_none: Pick a skill on the main page
screen.magical.loadout_switch: Scroll to choose, release to switch
message.magical.loadout_overflow: Loadouts replaced the skill wheel. %s skill(s) did not fit and were unequipped - rebind them in the Codex.
message.magical.long_debt_honoured: The bargain closes. It was owed and it was paid.
passive.magical.willing.desc: You stopped arguing with it. Corruption costs you three tenths less in mana and barrier, and arrives a fifth faster.
passive.magical.ledger.desc: You keep the books. Your Corruption and the next threshold above it are shown plainly, and no single cast may add enough to carry you past two of them at once.
message.magical.corruption_threshold_2: The dark is settling in, and it is not leaving on its own.
message.magical.corruption_threshold_1: Something in you has started to give.
message.magical.corruption_threshold_4: The debt is called. Nothing comes back to you now.
skill.magical.long_debt.desc: Names one living thing and takes the payment first: every cooldown you own resets and stays reset while the bargain runs. Kill what you named before the time is out and the debt closes cheap. Fail, and the whole of it is charged to your Corruption in one entry.
skill.magical.effigy.desc: Binds a living thing to a straw figure planted at your feet. Every wound it takes after that - from you, from anything else, from the ground it falls onto - is written into the doll, and when the doll's time is up the whole ledger lands on it at once, wherever in the world it has run to.
passive.magical.corruption_curse.desc: Your Corruption reached its ceiling and something came to collect. Mana no longer returns to you on its own. Nothing dispels this while the debt is still at the top - clear some of it first.
message.magical.corruption_threshold_3: You are more debt than mage now.
skill.magical.sever_the_thread.desc: A thrown cut that barely scratches anything healthy. Against something already all but finished it does not deal damage at all - it ends the thread, and charges you Corruption for exactly the health it did not have to go through. Very large creatures are beyond cutting.
message.magical.long_debt_defaulted: You did not deliver. The whole of the Long Debt is yours.
message.magical.long_debt_named: %s is named. Everything now, and the reckoning after.
skill.magical.umbral_tenancy.desc: Steps into a living thing's shadow. You are carried a pace behind it, unseen, and anything hunting you loses the thread - but you go where it goes, not where you want. You come out behind it with its back turned and the next spell you cast already loaded.
skill.magical.purification.desc: A rite drawn on the ground beneath you. Everyone standing in it - you included - is stripped of every harmful effect and has a quarter of their Corruption burned away, which is the only way in the world that debt ever comes off. Expensive, and slow to come back.
